title: clipos infrastructure
description: The Azure resources behind clipos: App Service, Postgres, Blob Storage and Log Analytics.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AppServiceConsoleLogs
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| extend app = extract(@"/sites/clipos-([a-z]+)-", 1, _ResourceId)
| extend j = parse_json(extract(@"(\{.*\})", 1, ResultDescription))
| extend level = iff(isnull(j), "TEXT", tostring(j.level)), msg = tostring(j.message), target = tostring(j.target), job_kind = tostring(j.spans[0].kind)
| where app == "api" and msg == "listening"
| project TimeGenerated, text = strcat("api started: ", substring(tostring(j.version), 0, 7))

panels.title: Memory by app
panels.description: Working set per container. The B2 plan has 3.5 GB.

panels.title: Health checks
panels.description: Share of /healthz checks that passed. App Service replaces an instance after 5 minutes of failures.

panels.title: Container events

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AppServicePlatformLogs
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated) and Level in ("Error", "Warning")
| extend app = extract(@"/sites/clipos-([a-z]+)-", 1, _ResourceId)
| summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, $__interval), series = strcat(app, " ", tolower(Level))
| order by TimeGenerated asc

panels.description: App Service platform warnings and errors per app: failed starts and stops, mostly around deploys.

panels.title: CPU credits
panels.description: B1ms is burstable: at 0 credits the server is held to its 20% CPU baseline.

panels.title: Connections
panels.description: Failed logins also raise the clipos-postgres-failed-connections alert (over 10 in 15 minutes).

panels.title: Postgres errors

azureLogAnalytics.query:
PGSQLServerLogs
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated) and ErrorLevel in ("ERROR", "FATAL", "PANIC")
| project TimeGenerated, level = ErrorLevel, code = SqlErrorCode, message = Message
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 200

panels.description: A FATAL line names the role that failed to log in; the connection line before it (same session) has the client address.

panels.title: Used capacity
panels.description: Originals, transcodes, posters and models. Azure reports it about once an hour.

panels.title: Traffic
panels.description: Egress is mostly playback, which streams straight from Blob Storage.

panels.title: Ingestion per day

azureLogAnalytics.query:
Usage
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated) and IsBillable
| summarize sum(Quantity) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1d), DataType
| order by TimeGenerated asc

panels.description: The workspace's daily cap is 100 MB (0.1 GB): past it, ingestion stops until 00:00 UTC.
